scope: M157 r2 analyzer, contract and frozen result; fresh exact recomputation plus an independent pre-M157 event-mask reconstruction, per-key conservation audit, adjacent bank/address audit, cycle arithmetic audit and admission review

score.disposition: GO for the frozen 20-record tuple/cache census and heldout adjacent one-cycle RMW-hazard result. NO-GO for a universal no-forward schedule, cache execution recurrence, Acc19 guard removal, the 1.803703226x or 1.756938227x ratios as hardware speedup, physical PPA, system speedup or headline use.

synthetic_ordering_attack.interpretation: source->half->row does not universally eliminate hazards. The frozen zero relies on every active source-context having both halves, which forces a half1-to-half0 address-bit change at every cross-source boundary. A future one-half context needs an explicit reorder/bubble/forward fallback.

read_reduction_audit.numerator_definition: one destination-vector group per source event
read_reduction_audit.denominator_definition: distinct cached destination-vector groups across rows for each record/window/partition/source
read_reduction_audit.reason_not_incremental_vs_m152: M152 already uses the same 8,271,296 source/destination cached groups and charges 24,813,888 = 3 times 8,271,296 weight-load tokens. M157 makes that assumed reuse schedule explicit; it does not remove those tokens from the frozen candidate recurrence.

pingpong.extra_definition: one startup per nonempty partition-window context

cycle_sensitivity_audit.accounting_risk: Both alternatives start from M152, which already charges all cached vector payload groups at three tokens each. The extra terms are valid only as additional launch/startup costs. No port-level mapping proves whether they are extra work, replacement work, or hidden work; ping-pong also lacks a load-to-use/contention recurrence. Thus the formulas neither prove absence of double charging nor absence of omitted stalls.

integer_and_acc19_audit.interpretation: The heldout correction population alone has a safe worst-sign bound, but M157 does not replay signed values, the PWP/base accumulator state, or every source-major prefix. Acc19 guard removal therefore remains inadmissible.

findings.title: Zero adjacent RMW hazard is exact on heldout but is not guaranteed by source-half-row order alone
findings.evidence: Independent reconstruction checks all 46,971,957 adjacent pairs and finds zero. This happens because all 1,033,912 active source-contexts contain both halves and all eight destinations, leaving zero same-half phase boundaries. A synthetic pair of one-row half0 phases at row7/bank0 produces one unavoidable bubble in both natural and optimized order.
findings.impact: A different density/window with a one-half source context can require a bubble or forwarding. Removing M155 forwarding solely from the heldout zero would be unsafe.
findings.required_action: Encode and assert the both-halves invariant, or retain a bank/address comparator with reorder/bubble fallback, then replay broader Motion and Local5 strata in RTL.

findings.title: Ping-pong and nonoverlap formulas are arithmetic sensitivities, not a bound port-level cache recurrence
findings.evidence: M152 already charges 24,813,888 = 3 x 8,271,296 cached weight-load tokens. M157 separately adds either 68,820 context startups or 2,067,824 phase cycles while declaring the phase load not already covered, but provides no mapping showing whether the new cycles are launch overhead, replacement payload service or hidden prefetch.
findings.impact: The two alternatives are not summed with each other, but either can double-charge existing load work or omit load-to-use/contention stalls depending on the eventual macro ports. Neither 1.803703226x nor 1.756938227x is executable hardware evidence.
findings.required_action: Replace the scalar additions with a cycle recurrence driven by exact cache requests, bank ports, payload beats, ping-pong ownership, short-phase overlap, backpressure and source-key transitions.

findings.title: Integer commutativity and Acc19 fault equivalence are not numerically closed
findings.evidence: Tuple masks are exact, but descriptor negate and signed vector payloads are not replayed. The heldout correction-only population bound is 1208 x 128 = 154,624 and fits signed19, while the architectural 6912 x 128 bound is 884,736 and does not. PWP/base accumulator headroom and source-major prefix extrema are absent.
findings.impact: Exact mathematical addition is commutative, but a finite accumulator with reject-on-overflow can be order-sensitive. Runtime overflow detection and forwarding cannot be removed from count-only evidence.
findings.required_action: Run a checkpoint-derived signed baseline-vs-source-major miter over every accumulator prefix, include PWP/base state, prove Acc19 headroom and compare overflow/fault timing.

findings.title: 22.747159575x is only an uncached-to-cached vector-group read ratio
findings.evidence: Its numerator is 188,148,490 event vector groups and denominator is 8,271,296 distinct cached groups. M152 already charges exactly this denominator at three load tokens per group.
findings.impact: The ratio is neither cycle speedup nor incremental M157 improvement over the M152 recurrence and cannot support an accelerator headline.
findings.required_action: Keep the ratio labeled memory-work reduction and report incremental accepted cycles, bytes, SRAM accesses and energy only after the executable cache recurrence exists.

findings.title: Cache, accumulator macro, identity and context boundaries remain model cuts
findings.evidence: There is no source-cache RTL/macro, bound accumulator SRAM, integrated M154 path, payload loading, context identity wrapper, commit/drain path or commercial PPA receipt for M157.
findings.impact: The DSE does not establish capacity, port feasibility, physical timing, energy, fault atomicity or lossless context transitions.
findings.required_action: Implement and seal the smallest fused cache-to-accumulator module with exact SRAM cuts and identity/fault assertions before further performance admission.

findings.title: The useful both-halves invariant is frozen-extent-specific
findings.evidence: The census covers 20 H67/Motion ep35 records, sample IDs5..9 and four operators. No Local5 or event-density/equal-rate stratification is present.
findings.impact: The invariant and zero-bubble observation may not survive a different checkpoint, line, sequence or density regime.
findings.required_action: Repeat the exact invariant/hazard census on Local5 and broader Motion sequences before hard-wiring no-forward behavior.

validated_strengths: The original four-entry manifest verifies, and a fresh analyzer run produces a byte-identical result.
The 20 records are exactly sample IDs 5 through 9 crossed with operator indices 0 through 3; all packed payload and weight identities verify.
Independent reconstruction does not import M157 and obtains zero per-key descriptor mismatches, exact source-event/source-key totals and identical source/scheduled event-mask SHA256.
All context-internal adjacent descriptor pairs are accounted for and zero same-bank/same-address hazards are exact for the frozen extent.
The 22.747159575x, 1.803703226x and 1.756938227x arithmetic values reproduce exactly.
The r2 contract correctly marks integer miter, RTL, cache/accumulator macro, speedup, PPA and headline admission false.

admitted: Zero adjacent one-cycle same-bank/same-address hazards on that extent
22.747159575x vector-group read-work reduction versus uncached per-event reads
Arithmetic cycle sensitivities under their scalar startup assumptions
not_admitted: Signed integer reorder or overflow/fault equivalence
Physical speedup, system speedup, DATE headline or best-paper readiness
